ModMetaData.name: Haul After Harvest
ModMetaData.author: tk421storm
ModMetaData.description: After harvesting plants, chopping trees, milking or shearing animals, mining, deconstructing, stripping, extracting skulls or fishing, a colonist hauls the closest haulable item nearby to storage before moving on.\n\nSettings: search radius (default 5 cells), haul before more of the same work further than 20 cells away, enable for plants / trees / animals / mining / deconstruction / stripping / skull extraction / fishing, only colonists with Hauling enabled. Each growing zone has a toggle to turn it off.
